name: Hooked axe
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, Ultimate Combat pg. 144
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, Ultimate Combat pg. 144
Statistics
Cost 20 gp Weight 7 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type S; Special disarm, performance, trip
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Axes
Description
The hooked end of this axe’s blade can be used to disarm foes or pull them off balance. A hooked axe can be used as a martial weapon (in which case it functions like a battleaxe).
